conceptZh: 竹節積木排成清楚的「竹」，蜘蛛人玩具機器人拉動旁邊的彈簧竹竿，反被輕輕彈成坐姿。
object: Bamboo-shaped interlocking toy bricks, a spring-loaded bamboo stalk, and a mechanical Spider-Man toy robot.
morph: Six bamboo-green brick strokes already form the correct glyph. A separate springy bamboo stalk provides the gag while the glyph stays rigid; all props withdraw before the final hold.
creativeAngle: 字形先完整呈現，笑點由旁邊竹竿的回彈製造；機器人使勁拉竹子，最後竟被彈坐下，避免拉扯筆畫而妨礙辨字。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated toy-tabletop video with a locked frontal camera, soft warm lighting, and a pale peach background. Center the single Traditional Chinese glyph「竹」throughout, uncropped, approximately 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Build its correctly formed six strokes from saturated bamboo-green LEGO-style interlocking bricks: two short descending-left strokes, two short horizontal strokes, a left vertical stroke, and a right vertical stroke ending in its proper hook. Preserve standard printed proportions and stroke spacing. Subtle bamboo joints suggest the plant without breaking the solid green silhouettes.

Use one coherent toy Spider-Man theme. A tiny red-and-blue mechanical Spider-Man robot has a molded mask, visible hinge joints, and mitten-shaped toy hands. Beside the glyph, entirely within the right margin, stands a separate miniature bamboo stalk on a spring base. At 0.0–1.4 seconds, the robot attaches a soft toy web to this stalk and plants its feet. At 1.4–2.6 seconds, it leans backward with comically excessive effort; the bamboo bends only a little. Pause briefly in anticipation. At 2.6–3.7 seconds, the stalk gently springs upright, tugging the robot into a tiny hop and a surprised seated pose on a round toy cushion. Its hinged legs point straight forward for the payoff. Keep this small action beside the glyph, never across its strokes. Add a quiet spring boing and soft cushion squeak. By 4.4 seconds, a small recessed platform smoothly lowers the robot, cushion, web, and separate stalk out of sight. From 4.4–8.0 seconds, hold only the complete, motionless green「竹」against the light background, with its shape and position unchanged.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin. The ONLY spoken line is exactly「竹、竹、竹林」. Speak the first「竹」around 0.5 seconds, the second around 1.6 seconds, and「竹林」naturally around 5.3–6.3 seconds during the clear final hold. Silent pronunciation directions: 竹 = ㄓㄨˊ, pinyin zhú; 竹林 = ㄓㄨˊ ㄌㄧㄣˊ, pinyin zhú lín. Give all three occurrences of 竹 the identical zhú reading. Bopomofo and pinyin are pronunciation directions only, never spoken or displayed. Stop speaking after 竹林. Keep sound effects soft and use no background music. Display only the single target glyph; omit subtitles, vocabulary text, logos, written character names, watermarks, clutter, and flashing effects.
direction:
孩子偏好：機器人、蝙蝠俠、搞笑、足球、戰鬥機器人、豬探長、樂高積木、漫威。This clip should use ONE coherent theme, not a crowded crossover. Theme: A toy Spider-Man robot and bamboo-shaped LEGO-style bricks; a harmless toy web pulls a springy bamboo stalk and gently bounces the robot into a funny seated pose. Use clearly stylized toys or cartoon animals; costume characters must be obviously toy/robot figures. Keep the character itself and its meaning central; the prop gag is brief and the final glyph remains correct, unobstructed, large and still for at least 3 seconds. No logos or written character names on screen.
PRONUNCIATION LOCK: target 竹, Bopomofo ㄓㄨˊ, Mandarin pinyin zhú. The ONLY spoken line must be exactly "竹、竹、竹林". Example word is fixed as 竹林, pronounced zhú lín. Do not substitute a word. Both isolated readings and the target syllable inside the word must have exactly the same reading. Include this exact spoken line and these pronunciation guides explicitly in promptEn, stating that Bopomofo/pinyin are silent pronunciation directions, never spoken or displayed. Use clear Taiwanese Mandarin, no extra dialogue, no character catchphrases. Avoid other polyphonic examples or reading alternatives anywhere in the narration instructions. Themes affect the visual gag only, never the spoken vocabulary.

conceptZh: 竹製的「竹」像小英雄身旁的高大竹架；右下的小鉤勾住超長披風，英雄一走，披風就翻上頭頂。
object: A solid green bamboo-textured glyph and an original caped action figure with an excessively long fabric cape.
morph: Begin with the complete six-stroke glyph. Its right terminal hook briefly catches the cape; the glyph remains rigid and correctly formed throughout.
creativeAngle: 把「竹」右下的鉤變成披風意外的起點：愛擺姿勢的小英雄被自己的長披風蓋住頭，最後學會把披風捲好再走。以布料動作取代前版的彈簧反彈，字形全程穩定。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized animated scene with a locked frontal camera, warm soft lighting, and a light apricot background. Center one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph, 「竹」, filling approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. Use a standard Traditional Chinese print form with six distinct strokes: each half has a short descending-left stroke and a short horizontal stroke; the left half ends in a straight vertical, and the right half ends in a vertical with its proper small terminal hook. Render the strokes in saturated solid bamboo green with subtle recessed bamboo-node texture that never interrupts their silhouettes. Keep the complete glyph rigid, centered, uncropped, and readable throughout.

The sole animated lead is an original, proudly theatrical caped action-figure hero with a rounded turquoise plastic body, clearly visible toy joints, a simple orange domino mask, and a plain golden fabric cape three sizes too long. Give the costume no emblem. The glyph is the only supporting object. Keep the tiny hero and the cape action beside its lower-right edge, leaving the strokes exposed.

At 0.0–1.2 seconds, the hero poses beside the towering bamboo glyph, chest puffed out, then begins a grand march toward screen right. His trailing cape hem catches on the glyph’s small right terminal hook. At 1.2–2.1 seconds, he takes one determined step, feels the gentle resistance, and pauses with one foot proudly raised. At 2.1–3.0 seconds, his next exaggerated step pulls the loose cape up and over his own head like an enormous fabric hood. His triumphant arms remain raised for a beat before his mitten hands pat around for his missing face. Use a soft fabric flap, with no impact. The cape billows outward into the clear right margin, never across the glyph.

At 3.0–4.7 seconds, he lifts the fabric off his face, looks back at the tiny hook, carefully frees the hem, and hurriedly rolls the absurdly long cape into a fat bundle under one arm. He gives a small satisfied nod and waddles out to the right carrying it. From 4.7–8.0 seconds, hold only the complete, motionless 「竹」 for 3.3 uninterrupted seconds.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin. The exact entire spoken line is 「竹、竹、竹子」. Say the first 「竹」 at approximately 0.4–0.9 seconds, the second at 1.3–1.8 seconds, and 「竹子」 at 5.4–6.3 seconds during the clear final hold. Pronounce 竹 as ㄓㄨˊ and 竹子 as ㄓㄨˊ ˙ㄗ. Stop after the word. Keep fabric sounds quiet and use no music. The vocabulary is audio only. The sole visible writing is 「竹」; use no subtitles, other text, logos, watermarks, clutter, or flashing effects.
